title: Learning Timeline-Preserving Speech-to-Speech Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.00690v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) increasingly preserves what is said and how it sounds, but not necessarily when speech and silence occur. For dubbing and other temporally grounded applications, matching total duration is not enough: speech and pauses must also occur at corresponding moments. We formulate timeline-preserving S2ST, which aims to preserve the source endpoint and salient internal pauses on a shared absolute timeline. We present TransDubber, an end-to-end autoregressive system that learns this temporal structure directly from aligned target waveforms, without inference-time frame-level timing control or post-hoc temporal correction. To provide this supervision, we construct 642K exactly duration-matched English-Chinese speech pairs by translating and synthesizing target speech on source-defined temporal scaffolds. translated_title: 学习时间线保持型语音到语音翻译
translated_abstract: 语音到语音翻译（S2ST）日益能够保留说话的内容与声音风格，但并不一定保留语音和停顿发生的时间点。对于配音（dubbing）以及其他具有时间对齐要求的应用来说，仅匹配总时长是不够的：语音和停顿还必须出现在相应的时刻。我们提出了时间线保持型语音到语音翻译（timeline-preserving S2ST）这一任务形式，其目标是在共享的绝对时间轴上保留源语音的结束点以及显著的内部停顿。我们提出了 TransDubber，这是一个端到端的自回归系统，它直接从对齐的目标波形中学习这种时间结构，无需推理时的帧级时间控制或事后时间校正。为了提供这种监督信号，我们通过在由源语音定义的时间骨架上进行翻译并合成目标语音，构建了 64.2 万条时长精确匹配的英中语音对。训练结合了渐进式监督课程学习与验证器引导的强化学习，以平衡……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出时间线保持型语音到语音翻译新任务及端到端自回归系统 TransDubber，可直接在共享绝对时间轴上保留源语音的结束点和显著内部停顿，无需推理时的时间控制或事后校正。
